يحترق (form VIII)
# يَحْتَرِقُ (yaḥtariqu) /jaħ.ta.ri.qu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَقَ (iḥtaraqa)
# يَحْتَرِقَ (yaḥtariqa) /jaħ.ta.ri.qa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَرَقَ (iḥtaraqa)
# يَحْتَرِقْ (yaḥtariq) /jaħ.ta.riq/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَرَقَ (iḥtaraqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
